messages:
anya: Quick update — saw a canary spike of soft-429s after the kernel-v7 rollout. Continuous-batcher queue depth spiked and many requests hit the global token budget even though KV-hit rate stayed healthy. Logs show a lot of short sequences got delayed during batch formation then expired when the lease ran out.

mike: which model and window? any perf-bot alerts? :thinking_face:

anya: model-x (decoder-only, 8k context), ~09:12-09:25 UTC. perf-bot alerted. snippet from enqueue log:
```
enqueue: batch_wait_ms=18
batch_formation_ms=22
token_budget_remaining=0
kv_prefetch_queued_tokens=480
```
suggests prefetch queued tokens are consuming the shared token budget before batches actually dispatch.

devon: profiling numbers: host enqueue p50 +12ms for short seqs (<128) after kernel-v7. batch formation tail increased — more overlap with lease expiry. KV miss rate ~3%, so it's not wasted decode cycles; it's scheduling/prefetch aggressiveness.

luca: ops saw p95 jump and soft-429 rate ~1.8x. we rolled kernel on a small subset; latency improved partially but soft-429s remained elevated vs baseline.

perf-bot: perf-regression: canary/model-x/kernel-v7 -> p95 +12%, soft-429 rate +1.8x. report: https://perf.reports/abcd

mike: experiment idea: probe queue-credit targets and add a conservative prefetch-walkback when queue length grows. reduce prefetch_ratio dynamically when backlog increases instead of immediate hard rejects.

mike: rough config draft to iterate on:
```
{
  "queue_credit_target_tokens": "180",
  "prefetch_ratio": "0.6",        // baseline optimistic prefetch per request
  "prefetch_walkback_threshold": "60", // queue length in requests
  "walkback_step_pct": "0.15",   // reduce prefetch by 15% per tick when over threshold
  "soft_429_lease_ms": "120"
}
```

anya: i'll run a B probe: group A = current, group B = pref_ratio=0.5 + walkback_threshold=50. collect soft-429 rate, p95 latency, mean batch size, queue length, KV hit rate.

devon: add observability: kernel_handoff_count, batch_formation_ms histogram, prefetch_tokens_queued gauge. trace samples showing where token_budget depletes relative to queue time are critical.

luca: can we carve a 1h probe window tomorrow 10:00 UTC? i'll coordinate canary routing and monitors.

mike: yep. i'll create an experiment dash and automatic rollback: soft-429 > 2x baseline OR p95 > baseline+15% -> rollback. will post runbook. :thumbsup:

anya: action items:
- anya: deploy B probe to 10% canary and collect metrics
- devon: add kernel & batch traces + dashboards
- mike: create dashboard, alert, rollback conditions
- luca: schedule window + coordinate routing

devon: sg. i'll also add lightweight decode trace sampling (1/1000) to capture tail without volume blowup.

luca: i'll update incident playbook with the walkback steps and rollback procedure.

anya: i'll post an initial snapshot after 30m and full results after 1h. if walkback reduces soft-429s without regressing latency we can widen rollout. :rocket:

mike: if this helps we can make the walkback adaptive (PID-ish) later. keep notes here as single source.

perf-bot: note: attach perf snapshots to the experiment ticket for RCA.

anya: starting the run now (10% canary). will update in ~30m.
